appearances.title: Hermes Agent closes Jensen Huang's GTC Berlin keynote by building a robot training environment
appearances.summary: In NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, a customized open-source Hermes Agent was set up from one prompt on an RTX Spark, then planned an obstacle course with Nemotron, had another model build it with FreeCAD, Omniverse, Blender, Newton and Isaac Lab, and trained simulated Hugging Face Microduck robots until a policy was ready for the real robot.
